Ravi RS Project Manager +91 9894395990 / raviramesh.gejji@gmail.com / Bangalore, India

Accomplished Senior Project Manager and Delivery Lead with over 18 years of experience spearheading complex digital transformations and core banking modernization, Digital Transformation initiatives globally. Managed complex global engagements, fostering high-level stakeholder and leveraging robust Agile (Scrum/SAFe) expertise to scale delivery seamlessly. Proven expert in digitalizing customer journeys and mobile banking across critical pillars (Cards, Payments, Customer Service, and Security, Compliance).

Core Competencies: Core banking system modernization, Predictive Customer Experience Management CSAT Maximization, Business Operations Next-Gen Tech Lifecycle Adoption, Quantum & Deep Tech Digital Transformation Operational Re-engineering, Structured Client On boarding & Change Mgmt Card centre operations, Regulatory compliance Account Governance & Trust, AI-Safe &Safe Cyber Security, Risk Mitigation, Security SLA Compliance

Work experience TFSL | Bangalore, India Project Manager | Nov 2023 – June 2026 •

End-to-End Delivery & Strategic Governance, Successfully managed day-to-day execution, milestone tracking, and budget adherence for high-impact banking cards and digital transformation projects.

Managed and secured formal sign-offs on comprehensive project charters, master plans, stakeholder





matrices, and centralized risk/issue logs to establish clear operational guardrails. Partnered closely with Project Sponsors to validate cost-benefit analyses, ensuring execution roadmaps remained strictly aligned with the bank’s broader strategic and commercial goals. Conducted deep-dive, interpretive data analysis to identify complex operational bottlenecks, developing innovative, risk-mitigated solutions to keep delivery timelines on track.

Demonstrated rigorous risk management by safeguarding corporate reputation, driving compliance with financial regulations, and maintaining full transparency in escalating and reporting control issues.

Resource Optimization, Held full management accountability for cross-functional delivery teams, handling resource planning, hiring, performance evaluations, and talent development.

Optimized team staffing models across multiple interconnected project areas, actively monitoring commitment levels and adjusting allocations to meet tight project deadlines.

Utilized developed communication and diplomacy skills to guide, influence, and align multi-layered



stakeholders, including technical teams, business units, and external clients. Facilitated collaborative scope-definition workshops to ensure all regional and functional stakeholders had a unified understanding of project schedules, critical milestones, and delivery expectations.

Monitored and managed third-party vendor performance, enforcing service level agreements (SLAs) and taking proactive corrective actions whenever vendor delivery lagged.

ACCENTURE SOLUTIONS PVT LTD | Bangalore, India Team Lead / Consultant - PCS | Feb 2017 – Nov 2023 •

Led the end-to-end implementation of complex digital banking and card transformation projects, consistently delivering on scope, timeline, and budget constraints. Collaborated with cross-functional leadership to define robust business cases, establishing clear project objectives, comprehensive cost-benefit analyses, resource allocations, and technical feasibility frameworks for steering committee approval.



Developed detailed project blueprints to meticulously track tasks, milestones, budgets, and risks, ensuring potential bottlenecks were mitigated before impacting delivery schedules.

Managed end-to-end financial health and post-implementation benefits realization plans, tracking ROI and



business outcomes to ensure long-term value alignment. Led end-to-end delivery of global, high-risk digital transformation programs, including complex data science, AI/ML, and Agentic AI Global Payments platforms integrated across multiple international payment gateways.

• Advised and presented a streamlined digital product framework to client leadership, introducing a predictable,

repeatable, and flexible delivery model to scale innovative application features effectively.

Defined long-term transformation strategies and managed project portfolios across multiple client divisions, using data-driven judgment and advanced scheduling to consistently meet critical enterprise deadlines. • Designed and maintained centralized project repositories, ensuring all documentation, governance sign-offs,





and historical lessons learned were standardized for audit readiness. Created high-visibility dashboards and executive reports, providing senior leadership with transparent, real- time insights into project health, resource optimization, and delivery metrics. Championed Agile and Scrum methodologies within traditional banking environments, coaching internal teams and stakeholders on modern project management techniques to foster a culture of continuous improvement.

Managed critical relationships with external vendors, consultants, and system integrators, successfully negotiating contracts and deliveries while safeguarding the bank’s operational and financial interests.

Navigated complex organizational change, serving as a bridge between technical teams and business units to





drive smooth adoption of new card and digital banking features. Fostered a highly collaborative, team-oriented culture, utilizing strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills to keep global delivery teams aligned and motivated under tight deadlines. Led operational capability transformation initiatives within mid-sized to large organizations (5000+ employees), bridging the gap between technical SaaS capabilities and executive business goals.

Owned end-to-end delivery of a financial risk technology portfolio spanning 5+ initiatives, ensuring alignment with business, regulatory, and compliance goals across multi-region stakeholder engagement across US, UK, and APAC teams.

Delivered enterprise-scale digital transformation programs ($1M–$5M) across multi-region teams with >95% stakeholder satisfaction. Led SOW preparation, pricing models, effort estimation, and resource planning to optimize delivery outcomes. Implemented Agile, Scrum, Kanban, and Hybrid models, improving sprint velocity by 20–25%.

• • Managed cross-functional teams of up to 40 members across engineering, data, compliance, and business functions.

Past Project Excellence & Cross-Enterprise Governance Cloud Migration & Core Banking UX/UI Modernization This project focuses on the UXDA/ITTI Digital transformation involving a legacy core system's cloud transition and complete user experience overhaul. •

Led a massive multi-module core banking transformation, successfully migrating a legacy, 15-year-old on- premise banking solution into a highly scalable, cloud-based SaaS platform.

Managed the modernization of complex, interconnected banking pillars, including Loans, Savings, Cards,



Payments, Cash & Treasury, CRM, Risk Management (SGR), and Regulatory Reporting. I partnered with specialized financial UX/UI architects to execute a rigorous user-centered research and design methodology, analyzing daily paint points of banking personnel to eliminate human error.

Achieved improvement in operational efficiency, reducing the standard employee system learning curve from several weeks to just a few hours, while significantly boosting transaction service speeds.

Aligned multi-layered stakeholder visions (ranging from executive boards to technical delivery teams) through thorough product audits, competitor benchmarking).

Modernized AML and transaction monitoring platforms for Charles Schwab using Generative AI, Agentic AI, and AWS Cloud. • Deployed Actimize fraud and compliance solutions for USAA banking and insurance operations. • • Achieved annual cost savings through delivery optimization and automation initiatives. •

Executed 10+ TB cloud data migration to AWS with zero business disruption.

Improved team efficiency by ~30% via workflow optimization and API-based integrations.

TFSL | Bangalore, India. Project Manager / Consultant| Nov 2015 – Jan 2017

• Directed the end-to-end delivery of 3+ large-scale Digital banking Transformation projects, ensuring high-



quality outcomes across complex Industrial and Financial workstreams while maintaining 100% alignment with corporate strategy. Customer Journeys, Playbooks & Handoffs, Mapped end-to-end digital customer journeys and created standardized lifecycle management playbooks, streamlining critical process handoffs between sales, technical delivery, and renewal managers.

Represented the customer perspective in cross-functional technology workstreams, ensuring that client experience initiatives remained the primary focus during complex platform developments.

Developed targeted digital journey content and curated metrics tracking to help clients maximize the value of their software subscriptions.

Operations, Analytics & Platform Adoption, Managed the deployment of product analytics and usage data projects for large-scale digital platforms, utilizing agile software development methodologies to track performance. Supported global customer success operations by standardizing CRM and customer success platform workflows driving consistent platform usage across teams.



CUBE9 INFOTECH PVT LTD (Deputed to Vodafone India) | Pune/Bangalore, India Sr. Specialist, Consulting | Nov 2014 – Nov 2015 Global Outsourcing partner for Merchant Cash and Capital. − Engaged by a leading financial services client (in UK) to streamline Contact Centre performance reporting

requirements and outbound campaign expansion across 4 continents.

− Revitalized the use, and promoted the importance, of data derived insights, at different units of analysis,

−

support strategic planning and tactical decisions. Stressed the need for the creation and use of metrics/KPIs. Led the transition of global delivery centres from solution identification and diagnosis, in phases (Initiate, Plan, Execute, Control and Sustain) modelled on the PMI methodology

[24]7. ai | Bangalore, India. Senior Specialist – Operations Support | Feb 2004 – Nov 2014 •

Led the end-to-end strategy, delivery, and target-state architecture for client (Citibank and Barclays) global AI- powered customer engagement platforms, aligning technical execution roadmaps with client-centric digital transformation goals.

Directed multi-disciplinary, digital specialists to deliver high-complexity proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives, incorporating early machine learning and automated communication rules to solve real-world engagement challenges in digital banking.

Managed various banking/fintech projects ( Cards, Payments, customer service, banking technology delivery ) • Acted as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders, using human-centered data analysis to diagnose client journey friction points, which successfully migrated 40% of standard voice interactions to automated web channels. Partnered closely with Data Science and product development teams to build advanced predictive analytics models, optimizing conversion funnels and driving a 400% top-line revenue scale-up for a key business vertical.



Managed high-level stakeholder relationships and alliance networks to foster co-innovation, helping client



organizations transition to modern, data-driven operating models while successfully navigating complex, cross-functional corporate environments. Collaborated on large deal management and strategic sales enablement initiatives, translating complex machine learning and targeting capabilities into clear, value-driven business propositions for enterprise prospects.

Utilized deep market insights and user behavioral trends to tailor digital engagement strategies for banking, financial services, and retail clients, expanding the company's market footprint and securing executive project sponsorships.

From 2004 – 2009 - Workforce management & Capacity Planning •

Led comprehensive annual and monthly capacity planning cycles, directly designing scalable operating models and workforce frameworks to support large-scale enterprise delivery and business growth.

Managed comprehensive revenue assurance and commercial compliance frameworks, auditing diverse billing models (FTE, hourly, and transaction-based) to ensure accurate monthly accruals and maximize contract value realization. Partnered with finance and operations leadership to analyze pricing structures and account profitability, proactively identifying operational gaps, reviewing case trends, and mitigating financial risks across client portfolios.



Early Career Sri Venkateshwara Educational Group – Tiruvallur / Jun 1998 –Jan 2004 As Office Manager, I am responsible for the day-to-day running of the Chairman’s office and all facilities. Reporting to the Educational Trust Chairman.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS Bachelor of Science (Botany) from University of Madras, Madras in 1998 Prince2 Practitioner– P2R/IN072743 - APMG, Jan 2012. PMP trained / Agile Scrum / Design thinking, Client centered Solution
